question: What is the meaning of the geographical location of the operation in relation to geographical properties?
data_point: the geographical location of the operation
description: The geographical location of the operation refers to the specific place or area where the manufacturing or processing of materials or products takes place. In relation to geographical properties, this location can have implications on various aspects such as environmental impact, resource consumption, and life cycle assessment. Understanding the geographical location of the operation is crucial for evaluating the environmental footprint and sustainability of the products or materials being produced.

time. It helps in scheduling regular maintenance and anticipating po-
